json.Name: Idiocracy
json.Overview: To test its top-secret Human Hibernation Project, the Pentagon picks the most average European-Americans it can find - an Army private and a prostitute - and sends them to the year 2505 after a series of freak events. But when they arrive, they find a civilization so dumbed-down that they're the smartest people around.
Taglines: In the future, intelligence is extinct.

Chapters.Name: 10. The Smartest Guy in the World
